description: For every \(L\)-structure \(M\), relational matrix \(A\), and ground tuple \(\bar t\), the ground reading is true under \(b_M\) exactly when \(A\) is true at the tuple of term values \(\bar t^M\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.groundReading_realize.{u, v, z} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {M : Type z}
  [L.Structure M] {n : ℕ} (φ : L.BoundedFormula Empty n)
  (h : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.RelationalQF φ)
  (ts : Fin n → Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.GroundTerm L) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.eval (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.modelValuation M)
        (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.groundReading φ ts) =
      true ↔
    φ.Realize Empty.elim fun i => FirstOrder.Language.Term.realize Empty.elim (ts i)
